groups.description: The company this domain is modeled on: Eneve, formed in 2025 from Energy21, Ecedo, Jules and Gridhub with Vortex Capital Partners, and its 2026 Iberian add-on Nemon.

links.title: Eneve — Vortex investment page
links.relevance: The investor's own description: 2022 buyout, about 180 employees, over 90% of Dutch consumption data validated, largest implementation above 25 million connections, clients from Eneco and Essent to BASF and USG-Chemelot.

links.title: About Eneve — company history
links.relevance: The timeline from GEN (1997) and EBASE (2002) through Ecedo, Jules and Gridhub to the 2025 brand and the 2026 Nemon acquisition, the heritage behind the five products consolidated onto one platform.

links.title: Energy21, Ecedo, Jules and Gridhub join forces as Eneve
links.relevance: The 19 June 2025 merger release with 130+ specialists, 20+ million access points, 7 million households and 3 million business customers, and the CEO mission quote that frames the strategic spine.

links.title: Eneve expands to Spain and Portugal with the acquisition of Nemon
links.relevance: The 30 March 2026 release: Nemon Trade Energy, CRM and SIPS products, 100+ Iberian suppliers, 180 employees and EUR 30M+ expected turnover, the source of the Iberian supplier platform product.

links.title: Eneve emerges after merger of 4 energy firms (Silicon Canals)
links.relevance: Independent coverage of the merger with founding years, named clients (Axpo, BASF, Vattenfall, Eneco, Essent, Engie, Mega, Vandebron, Scholt) and the EUR 25M+ turnover projection.

links.title: La neerlandesa Eneve compra Nemon (Diari de Tarragona)
links.relevance: Local reporting on the Nemon deal: 34 employees in Ascó, about EUR 3 million 2025 revenue, roughly 100 retailer customers and the founders' reasoning for joining Eneve.

groups.description: Eneve's Supplier, Balancing & Shipping and Trade & Portfolio suites and the outcome pages that the product bricks and streams mirror.

links.title: Eneve — home
links.relevance: The scale claims (50+ energy companies, 20 million connections daily, 28 years) and the three-suite structure this domain's brick root groups follow.

links.title: Customer Onboarding
links.relevance: Automated intake and activation flows behind the onboard-and-switch stream and the intake and switching bricks.

links.title: Contract & Billing
links.relevance: Contract types, billing runs with VAT, guarantees of origin and split invoicing, reconciliation and exception handling, the scope of the bill-and-reconcile stream.

links.title: Customer Interfacing
links.relevance: The white-label portal, lifecycle touchpoints and case handling that the customer-interfacing bricks and the end-customer persona rely on.

links.title: Sourcing & Pricing
links.relevance: Position tracking, portfolio forecasting and structuring ('Track positions, spot risks, take action'), the basis of the source-and-price stream and the portfolio manager persona.

links.title: Intraday Portfolio Signal
links.relevance: Real-time steering signals and near real-time position updates, the intraday steering brick and stream.

links.title: BRP as a Service
links.relevance: The managed balance-responsibility offer: up to 53% lower imbalance cost, tiered MWh pricing from 40 GWh, guaranteed forecasting cycle, ETPA and TenneT integration, shadow forecasting before qualification.

links.title: Balancing & Shipping
links.relevance: Automated nominations and position management for electricity and gas, including gas shipping, the EBASE heritage behind the balancing suite.

links.title: Customer Trading
links.relevance: Click contracts, forecast management and self-service trading for business customers, the Jules heritage behind the industrial energy manager persona.

links.title: Launch energy products fast
links.relevance: The low-code proposition builder pitch ('From idea to live product. In weeks.') and the eighteen-month incumbent benchmark that sets the proposition manager's north star.

links.title: Enable customer self-service across web and mobile
links.relevance: The white-label portal and app outcome page with the easyEnergy and Mega Energy case figures on billing time, case resolution and churn.

links.title: Reduce cost to serve
links.relevance: The outcome page for the director persona's cost-to-serve target and the billing and service automation it depends on.

links.title: Stop imbalance costs
links.relevance: The outcome page for the BRP operator's imbalance-cost north star and the forecasting and steering loop behind it.

links.title: Launch as a new energy supplier
links.relevance: The entrant offer: platform, BRP as a Service and expertise services combined so a new supplier can go live in months, the new-entrant persona's journey.

links.title: Use case: market entry scan for the Netherlands and Spain
links.relevance: The five-workstream, five-week scan and the ACM (8–14 weeks) and CNMC (12–20 weeks) licensing lead times used in the entrant persona and the market-entry stream.

links.title: Expert services
links.relevance: Market enablement, academy training and customer services, the enabling teams that own no bricks but run the BRP desk, migrations and licensing support.

groups.description: The Dutch regulator, TSO and market-facilitation sources behind licensing, allocation, balancing and the contract-mix statistics in the insights.

links.title: A 2025 review on the Dutch energy market (Eneve blog)
links.relevance: Eneve's own summary of Allocation 2.0 tranche 3, the MMC-Hub, the 15-minute day-ahead switch, balance-delta timing and aFRR changes that the market-communication and balancing bricks implement.

links.title: Energiemonitor ACM: toename aantal dynamische contracten zet door
links.relevance: ACM's monthly monitor with the household contract mix (8% dynamic, 55% fixed, 37% variable as of July 2026) and day-ahead and gas price levels used for the pricing and portfolio insights.

links.title: Energieleveranciers met een vergunning (ACM)
links.relevance: The list of licensed small-consumer suppliers (52 for electricity, 50 for gas), the population of potential Dutch supplier tenants.

links.title: Eisen energievergunning (ACM)
links.relevance: The organisational, financial and technical requirements a new entrant must evidence to obtain a supply licence, the checklist behind the licensing step of the market-entry stream.

links.title: Financieel toezicht op energieleveranciers — voorjaar 2025 (ACM)
links.relevance: ACM's periodic financial supervision of licence holders, the reason entrants and directors need auditable margin, hedging and liquidity reporting from the platform.

links.title: Salderingsregeling stopt in 2027 (Rijksoverheid)
links.relevance: The government explanation of the end of net metering on 1 January 2027 and the feed-in compensation that replaces it, driving new propositions and bill changes for solar households.

links.title: Wet beëindiging salderingsregeling (36.611) — Eerste Kamer
links.relevance: The legislative record of the bill adopted by the Eerste Kamer on 17 December 2024, the legal basis for the 2027 billing change.

links.title: Tranche 3 gaat functioneel live! (MFF BAS)
links.relevance: The market-facilitation forum's go-live notice for Allocation 2.0 tranche 3 on 1 January 2025, the reconciliation process the allocation and settlement bricks implement.

links.title: Allocatie 2.0 tranche 3 (Energiedatawijzer)
links.relevance: The sector's implementation guide for the tranche 3 release, including transition plans and test documentation that platform vendors had to follow.

links.title: Reconciliatieprijs (TenneT)
links.relevance: TenneT's published reconciliation price, the value applied to reconciled volumes since tranche 3 and an input to the settlement brick and the BRP operator's reconciliation accuracy KPI.

links.title: Balancing markets (TenneT)
links.relevance: The TSO's description of imbalance settlement, aFRR, mFRR and FCR products that BRPs and BSPs nominate into and are settled against.

links.title: Slimme-metergegevens van kleinverbruiksaansluitingen (CBS)
links.relevance: CBS on the coverage and read rate of Dutch household smart meters, the raw material of the meter-data collection and validation brick.

groups.description: Spanish and Portuguese regulator and market-operator sources behind the Nemon-based Iberian expansion.

links.title: Informe de supervisión de los mercados minoristas de gas y electricidad 2024 (CNMC)
links.relevance: The regulator's retail-market report with 4,163 active retailers and the concentration figures that define the Iberian long-tail SaaS opportunity.

links.title: Contadores inteligentes integrados en el sistema de telegestión (CNMC)
links.relevance: CNMC's report that 98% of Spanish electricity meters were integrated in remote management by 2018 and billed on hourly readings, which makes hourly billing and consumption self-service the Iberian baseline.

links.title: OMIE Instruction 2/2025 — go-live of 15-minute market time unit trading
links.relevance: The Iberian market operator's instruction for 15-minute day-ahead trading from 30 September 2025 (delivery day 1 October 2025), the granularity the Iberian market-communication brick must handle.

links.title: OMIE — market information
links.relevance: Day-ahead and intraday results for MIBEL used as price-curve inputs for Iberian tenants.

groups.description: European market-coupling and price sources that set the pace of change for every tenant.

links.title: Market Coupling Steering Committee confirms go-live of 15-minute MTU in SDAC (Nord Pool)
links.relevance: The exchange's confirmation that the European day-ahead market moved to 15-minute blocks on trading day 30 September 2025 for delivery day 1 October 2025, aligning trading with imbalance settlement.

links.title: Single Day-ahead Coupling (ENTSO-E)
links.relevance: The TSO association's reference on how SDAC works, the mechanism BRPs nominate against and portfolio managers price from.

links.title: EU household electricity prices stable in 2025 (Eurostat)
links.relevance: Eurostat's second-half 2025 household price level (EUR 28.96 per 100 kWh EU average), the backdrop for margin-per-connection and pricing insights.

links.title: Electricity price statistics (Eurostat Statistics Explained)
links.relevance: The standing per-country household and non-household price series for comparing Dutch and Iberian tenants' price environments.
